svg.title: RadGraph GNN Workflow Diagram
svg.desc: End-to-end pipeline from CT scans to locoregional recurrence prediction using Graph Attention Networks

g.text: Resample to 1mm isotropic · define 5cm peritumoral region
Z-score norm · top-20 supervoxels by cosine similarity
Star graph: GTV hub + 20 SV spokes · edge = 3D distance
5 × GAT layers (4 heads · LayerNorm per graph)
